lines.text: Astra's player has a Playback menu: speed, sleep timer, repeat a part, sound only. Chapter marks and pinch to zoom.
Skip intro works: Astra learns a series' opening from its sound, on your phone. Anime subtitles show their signs.
Audio has a Sound tab (volume boost, night mode, dialogue) and Stream info can sharpen the picture.
Films no longer download whole behind your back, seeks land in about a second, and streams say how they will play.
